_README: Panel member #1 (claude) candidate fill for baliforamericans. WORKING MATERIAL - not facts.json. 'verified' here means I opened that primary page on the checked_at date and the value is what the page said; it still needs the human promotion step. Everything marked verify_recommended with a null source was NOT opened and must not be published on this file's say-so.

locale.money_framing: express costs in USD with Indonesian rupiah (IDR) equivalents

_meta.destination: Bali (island and province of Indonesia), plus the Nusa islands and the Gili/Lombok side trip
_primary_sources_attempted_but_unreadabl: None outstanding. The three pages the fetch tool could not read (e-visa detail, All Indonesia, US Consular Agency Bali) were opened in Chrome on 2026-10-13.

_fact_field_shape: { value, source_url, status, notes } plus checked_at/source_kind where a primary page was opened.

capital.value: Denpasar is the provincial capital of Bali; Jakarta is the national capital
capital.notes: Indonesia is relocating national government functions to Nusantara; do not state a completed move without a source.

value: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
official_languages.notes: Balinese is widely spoken locally; English is common in tourist areas.

value: WITA (Central Indonesia Time), UTC+8, no daylight saving
timezones.notes: Bali and Lombok/Gili are UTC+8; Jakarta/Java is UTC+7.

power_plug_voltage.value: Type C and F plugs, 230 V, 50 Hz
power_plug_voltage.notes: US travelers need a plug adapter; check each device's label for 100-240 V before plugging in.

type.value: visa required; obtainable as an e-visa in advance or as a visa on arrival at the airport
type.notes: State Dept: 'A visa is required.' 'You can apply for a 30-day electronic visa in advance if arriving at airports in Jakarta or Bali.' 'You can purchase a visa upon arrival at the airport. You may need to wait in long lines.'

max_stay_days.notes: Read in the official visa finder with Passport = UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, purpose = General, Family, or Social, sub-purpose = Tourism, Family Visit, and Transit, visa = 'B1 - Tourist (Visa On Arrival)'. The finder has no per-visa URL; the path is the citation. Page: 'Stay: Up to 30 days (extendable for another 30 days)'. State Dept independently says a 30-day electronic visa.

fee.notes: Read in the official visa finder with Passport = UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, purpose = General, Family, or Social, sub-purpose = Tourism, Family Visit, and Transit, visa = 'B1 - Tourist (Visa On Arrival)'. The finder has no per-visa URL; the path is the citation. Rupiah figure only - never print a frozen USD equivalent. Good candidate for a fact-checker config only if a static official page carrying the same figure is found; this one is a script-driven wizard. SECOND primary source, and a STATIC page (found via the ChatGPT panel file, then opened by me 2026-10-13): https://ngurahrai.imigrasi.go.id/layanan-wna/ - 'Biaya Visa Kunjungan Saat Kedatangan sebesar Rp 500.000,-'; 30 days; 'dapat diperpanjang 1 (satu) kali'; lists Amerika Serikat among the eligible countries. This is the page to give the weekly checker (regex on 'Rp 500.000').

check_candidate.pattern: Biaya Visa Kunjungan Saat Kedatangan sebesar Rp\s*([0-9.]+)
check_candidate.note: proposal only - not yet a registered check config

processing_time.notes: Not stated on the pages opened.

online_authorization_required.value: Yes, separately from the visa: an arrival card via the All Indonesia system, completable only within 72 hours (3 days) before arrival; free; produces a QR code shown to Immigration and Customs
online_authorization_required.notes: State Dept: 'Complete an arrival card online or through the All Indonesia mobile app. The website will not allow you to complete the arrival card if you attempt to complete it more than 72 hours prior to your arrival... This service is completely free.' Official e-visa homepage agrees: 'All travellers are required to submit an arrival card within 3 (three) days prior arrival in Indonesia.' The All Indonesia site itself (https://allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id/) was opened in a browser: it offers arrival-card submission for foreign visitors and retrieval of a submitted card, but its help page does not state the timing window or cost, so those rest on the State Dept and e-visa homepage wording.

official_application_url.notes: URL as printed on the State Dept page; homepage opened and identifies itself as 'The Official e-Visa Website for Indonesia' (Directorate General of Immigration). Payment by 'SIMPONI or Mastercard, Visa or JCB credit/debit card'. e-VOA can be applied for up to 5 people at once.

evisa_application_window.value: apply and pay within 90 days of arrival; needs a valid passport, departure date and a booked return flight

visa_code.value: B1 - Tourist (Visa On Arrival); the US appears in the finder's eligible list for it
visa_code.notes: Read in the official visa finder with Passport = UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, purpose = General, Family, or Social, sub-purpose = Tourism, Family Visit, and Transit, visa = 'B1 - Tourist (Visa On Arrival)'. The finder has no per-visa URL; the path is the citation.

visa_validity_to_enter.notes: Read in the official visa finder with Passport = UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, purpose = General, Family, or Social, sub-purpose = Tourism, Family Visit, and Transit, visa = 'B1 - Tourist (Visa On Arrival)'. The finder has no per-visa URL; the path is the citation. Consistent with State Dept: apply within 90 days of arrival.

value: C1 - Tourist Single Entry Visitor Visa - 60 Days
D1 - Tourist Multiple Entry Visa (1, 2 or 5 years)
other_tourist_visas_offered.notes: Listed for a US passport under the tourism sub-purpose; fees and terms for these were not opened.

permitted_and_prohibited.value: Allowed: tourism and visiting friends or family, business discussions and site visits, medical treatment. Prohibited: selling goods or services; receiving rewards or wages from individuals or companies in Indonesia
permitted_and_prohibited.notes: Read in the official visa finder with Passport = UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, purpose = General, Family, or Social, sub-purpose = Tourism, Family Visit, and Transit, visa = 'B1 - Tourist (Visa On Arrival)'. The finder has no per-visa URL; the path is the citation.

tourist_levy.value: IDR 150,000 per person for foreign tourists entering Bali; separate from the visa; cashless payment online before travel or at designated counters at Bali's airport and seaport
tourist_levy.notes: Amount independently confirmed on the provincial site https://lovebali.baliprov.go.id/ ('IDR 150,000'; voucher 'sent to your Email' as a QR code; an exemption application exists). Whether it is charged per entry was not stated on either page.

overstay_penalty.value: IDR 1,000,000 per day, with possible detention, deportation or a re-entry ban; same exposure for entering on the wrong visa type

extension.value: the 30-day stay is 'extendable for another 30 days'
extension.notes: Read in the official visa finder with Passport = UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, purpose = General, Family, or Social, sub-purpose = Tourism, Family Visit, and Transit, visa = 'B1 - Tourist (Visa On Arrival)'. The finder has no per-visa URL; the path is the citation. The site has an 'Extend My Visa' entry point; the extension fee and whether a visa bought at the airport counter can be extended online were NOT read. The Ngurah Rai immigration office page adds: extendable once, at the immigration office for the foreigner's place of stay.

same_passport_exit_rule.value: you must leave on the passport you entered with; a replaced passport needs a 'special pass' from immigration before departure

scam_sites_to_avoid.notes: Look-alike visa and levy sites exist per secondary reports; no primary list read. Teach the pattern (only the two official domains) rather than naming sites.

passport_validity_required.value: 6 months beyond the arrival date and 2 blank pages; the 'endorsement' page at the back of the passport does not count as blank; entry is refused otherwise
passport_validity_required.notes: Three primary pages agree on 6 months (State Dept, official e-visa finder, US Consular Agency Bali). The endorsement-page detail is from the Consular Agency page.

onward_ticket_required.value: Yes - 'Outbound ticket from Indonesia' is listed among the documents to present to the immigration officer on arrival
onward_ticket_required.notes: Read in the official visa finder with Passport = UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, purpose = General, Family, or Social, sub-purpose = Tourism, Family Visit, and Transit, visa = 'B1 - Tourist (Visa On Arrival)'. The finder has no per-visa URL; the path is the citation. State Dept adds that the e-visa application needs a departure date and booked return flight.

traveling_with_children.value: carry each child's birth certificate copy or other proof of relationship; a minor may enter with one parent

notes.value: Carry a copy of the passport as proof of identity and visa status (State Dept).

emergency_passport.value: a limited-validity (emergency) passport requires a visa obtained before arrival, from an Indonesian embassy or consulate

approx_rate_note.notes: Never freeze. The State Dept page's dollar equivalent for the currency limit is itself a dated approximation.

cash_vs_card.value: Cash still needed for small vendors, drivers, entrance fees and many warungs; cards widely taken at hotels, larger restaurants and shops, often with a surcharge
cash_vs_card.notes: Not opened at a primary source today. General pattern; the surcharge practice needs a source before a percentage is stated.

atm_availability.value: ATMs are common in south Bali and Ubud and sparse on the Nusa islands and in the north/east
atm_availability.notes: Not opened at a primary source today. Per-transaction limits and operator fees appear in secondary results with inconsistent figures - leave figures out until sourced.

atm_fees.notes: Operator fee plus the US bank's own fees; both change. No figure stored.

currency_import_export_limit.value: Not a cap but a DECLARATION duty: cash and/or other payment instruments worth at least IDR 100,000,000 (rupiah or foreign equivalent) must be declared to Customs on entry or exit. Taking IDR 100,000,000 or more in rupiah OUT also needs a Bank Indonesia permit; bringing that much rupiah IN must be declared and checked for authenticity. An individual may not carry foreign banknotes worth IDR 1,000,000,000 or more. Not declaring: administrative penalty of 10% of the amount carried, capped at IDR 300,000,000
currency_import_export_limit.notes: Indonesian Customs FAQ citing PMK 100/PMK.04/2018. RESOLVES the panel dispute: the State Dept page's 'Entry maximum / Exit maximum: 100,000,000 rupiah' is a simplification; chatgpt and deepseek read it correctly as a declaration threshold. Never print the State Dept's dollar equivalent.

tipping_norm.value: Not obligatory. Many restaurant and hotel bills already add service and tax; small tips for drivers, guides and spa staff are customary
tipping_norm.notes: Not opened at a primary source today. The service/tax percentages must be sourced before being stated.

qr_payments.value: Bank Indonesia's cross-border QR scheme currently covers Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, South Korea and China; foreign visitors pay by scanning with their home country's payment app. The United States is not among the connected countries
qr_payments.notes: Central-bank page. So a US bank app or US wallet has no cross-border route to pay a QRIS code; whether any third-party tourist wallet works for a US visitor is a separate, unverified question (secondary reports describe an airport 'tourist travel pack').

main_international_airports.notes: Lombok (LOP) matters for the Gili/Lombok side trip.

buses.notes: Not opened at a primary source today.

domestic_flights.value: DPS has domestic links, including to Lombok and to Labuan Bajo for Komodo
domestic_flights.notes: Not opened at a primary source today. Baggage allowances and change fees vary by carrier and fare; secondary figures seen were inconsistent.

ride_sharing.value: Grab and Gojek operate; licensed taxis are widely available and Blue Bird is described as generally the most reliable
ride_sharing.notes: State Dept wording covers 'major Indonesian cities'. The Bali-specific pickup restrictions (airport, parts of Ubud and the Bukit) come from secondary sources only and are unverified.

car_rental_and_driving.value: A US licence alone is not recognized; foreign drivers must carry an International Driving Permit. Helmets are mandatory on motorcycles. Carry ID and vehicle registration. After an accident, stay and notify police. If fined, ask for an official receipt
car_rental_and_driving.notes: Driving is on the left (stable). Whether a US car-only licence plus IDP covers a scooter - the motorcycle-endorsement question - was NOT answered on the page and is the crux of two articles. BLOOD-ALCOHOL: deepseek alone gave limits (0.0% under 21, 0.05% otherwise); no primary source was found for any numeric limit, and a search surfaced an Indonesian law-journal comparison stating Indonesia has no BAC standard (the traffic law punishes driving without full concentration). Treat deepseek's figures as unsupported - do not publish. MOTORCYCLE ENDORSEMENT: still no primary source. Secondary Bali sites say the permit must carry the motorcycle category and name the 1968 convention; US-issued permits are a point to check specifically, since that is exactly what an American would hold. The police pages found concern Indonesians obtaining an international licence, not inbound visitors. US-ISSUED PERMIT: the AAA country list (https://cluballiance.aaa.com/travel/idp/international-drivers-permit-countries, opened 2026-10-13) lists 'Indonesia*' with the footnote 'Not party to 1949 Convention: International Driving Permit Honored' - so the AAA permit an American would carry is honored. The page says nothing about vehicle categories; the motorcycle-category requirement is still supported only by secondary Bali sites, one of which names the 1968 convention (in tension with the AAA note).

traffic_liability_note.value: in car-motorcycle collisions the driver of the larger vehicle is often presumed responsible

fast_boats.notes: No primary source exists in one place. Ports, operators and cancellation practice need operator and harbour-authority pages; safety record needs news/official sources. Nothing stored.

climate_by_season.value: Tropical: a drier season roughly April-October and a wetter season roughly November-March; warm all year
climate_by_season.notes: Month boundaries vary by year; use ranges. Rainfall figures need the meteorological agency (BMKG) before any number is printed.

Nyepi itself for anyone needing to arrive, depart or move that day

nyepi.value: Nyepi 2027 falls on Monday 8 March 2027 (Saka New Year 1949), a national holiday; it sits directly before the Eid al-Fitr holidays of 10-11 March 2027
nyepi.notes: SECONDARY: Kontan news report of the three-minister joint decree (SKB No. 1205/2026, 3/2026, 2/2026, signed 15 Sept 2026). The Religious Affairs Ministry page carrying the decree refused connections today; detik and other outlets showed the same date in search results. Airport closure hours for the day are NOT sourced.

galungan_kuningan.value: 2027 dates reported as Galungan 13 January and 11 August, Kuningan 23 January and 21 August
galungan_kuningan.notes: From a web-search summary of secondary pages (Wikipedia and Bali sites), not opened. The pair recurs every 210 days (pawukon calendar), which is stable.

advisory_level.value: Level 2 - Exercise increased caution (natural disasters, unrest, terrorism); Level 4 Do Not Travel applies only to Central Papua and Highland Papua
advisory_level.notes: Advisory 'Date issued: July 07, 2026' at the top of the page; the travel-guidance block shows 'Date issued: July 09, 2026'. Both dates are on the page - cite the advisory date and re-check.

main_risk.notes: Not opened at a primary source today. Widely reported; needs a citable source before being ranked as 'the main' risk.

drink_safety.value: State Dept warns of drink poisoning, 'like alcohol mixed with methanol or other deadly chemicals', and reports drink spiking and sexual assault in Bali, Lombok and the Gili Islands

drug_laws.value: Marijuana, cannabis and CBD products are illegal; some prescription medications, 'including those for ADHD', are illegal; customs does not publish a list of prohibited drugs; convictions can bring heavy fines, long sentences and, in extreme cases, the death penalty

medication_import.value: Indonesia's food and drug agency (BPOM): medicine carried in a passenger's own baggage for personal use needs no BPOM or Health Ministry approval, but ALL medicine brought from abroad must be backed by a doctor's prescription or a hospital recommendation, for at most 90 days' use; the traveler fills a special form and attaches the required documents. Over-the-counter medicines may come in without a prescription for at most 3 days' need. Psychotropic medicines may be carried in passenger baggage for at most 60 days' need. NARCOTIC-class medicines and precursors may NOT be brought in from abroad at all. Non-compliant medicine can be seized and destroyed by Customs
medication_import.notes: BPOM distribution-oversight directorate FAQ, section 'Pemasukan Obat untuk Penggunaan Pribadi Melalui Barang Kiriman dan Barang Bawaan Penumpang'. The page gives a BPOM WhatsApp and email contact for individual cases. Consistent with the State Dept warning that ADHD medication is illegal and no list is published. NOT determined: which US prescriptions Indonesia classes as 'narcotic' versus 'psychotropic' - a traveler must check their own drug's class; the article must say so rather than name drugs.

vaccines.value: None required for entry (State Dept). CDC recommends hepatitis A, hepatitis B and typhoid for most travelers, routine vaccines up to date, Japanese encephalitis for longer or higher-risk stays, and a pre-exposure rabies discussion

rabies.value: CDC: dogs infected with rabies are commonly found in Indonesia; avoid unfamiliar dogs, cats and wild animals; seek immediate medical attention if bitten

malaria.value: CDC: no malaria transmission in the resort areas of Bali or Java, the Gili Islands, or the Thousand Islands

dengue_zika.value: Dengue risk exists throughout Indonesia; CDC lists a Level 2 travel health notice for Zika cases in travelers returning from Bali
dengue_zika.notes: The notice was summarized to me as dated August 2026; re-open the notice itself before citing the date.

tap_water_safe.value: Not treated as drinkable; use bottled or filtered water
tap_water_safe.notes: Not opened at a primary source today. CDC says follow safe food and water practices; a Bali-specific statement was not read.

emergency_numbers.notes: Badung regency (the regency covering Kuta, Seminyak, Canggu, Jimbaran and the Bukit) communications office: 'Kepolisian = 110, Pemadam Kebakaran = 113, Basarnas = 115, Ambulan/Kemenkes = 119', with 112 as the free unified number. The national 112 page (https://layanan112.komdigi.go.id/tentang) confirms 112 is a single free emergency number run by local governments and reachable without credit. Panel note: chatgpt and deepseek both gave 'ambulance 118 or 119'; 118 was seen only in Google result snippets from other regional government sites, not opened.

_open_questions._note: Ranked by how much published work depends on them.
value: Scooters: does the permit need the motorcycle category, and does a US car-only licence qualify? AAA confirms its permit is honored in Indonesia; the category rule is still secondary-only. No numeric blood-alcohol limit could be sourced - do not publish one.

Medication: resolved in structure (prescription, 90 days; psychotropics 60 days; narcotics barred). Open: which class a given US prescription falls in, and what the 'special form' is called and where it is filed.
Nyepi: date for 2027 is secondary-sourced (8 March); airport closure hours unsourced. Galungan/Kuningan 2027 dates unopened.
Visa: extension fee, and whether a visa bought at the airport counter extends online.
Tourist levy: per entry or per trip; exemptions; enforcement.
Arrival paperwork timing: customs says two days before arrival, State Dept and the e-visa site say three.
